items.content_excerpt: $APLD Just seen this on T212 “An official 131-page Louisiana government meeting packet has come out containing a proposed agreement that would allow up to $4.6 billion in revenue bonds to finance $APLD's Delta Forge 1 campus. This is the 300 MW Louisiana project backed by approximately $7.5 billion in contracted hyperscaler revenue over 15 years from $META. The significance here is that we are seeing a specific financing structure emerge for one of $APLD's data centres The kicker is that $APLD wouldn't necessarily need to raise billions by issuing additional common shares. So no dilution of us. Instead, SAPLD could finance a substantial portion of construction through debt supported by the project's future cash flows. That matters enormously to shareholders concerned about dilution. The structure also includes a proposed long-term property-tax arrangement, with approximately $575 million in negotiated payments through 2052. That tax arrangement is separate from the bond financing.“

The reason has nothing to do with proferred excuse of confidentiality agreements. What it has to do with is the company’s desire to avoid community opposition being imported from outside the local community. This is how APLD does business and why it doesn’t have much community opposition. It’s smart. These folks are playing chesss - not checkers. ￼ The way both the company and its shareholders will make the most money is by getting these datacenters constructed promptly so that they can be turned over to the hyperscalers so that the hyperscalers will pay APLD recurring revenue in the billions of dollars. That’s the endgame. ￼ The company, to its credit, lavishes money on its host communities through APLD Cares, buying them lots of needed things and taking care of their people. They are not flashy. They are not showy. They’re just quietly getting the job done.

items.title: Google is expanding its AI chip lineup with two new specialized versions of its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), the TPU 8tx and 8i Max, as i
items.content_excerpt: Google is expanding its AI chip lineup with two new specialized versions of its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), the TPU 8tx and 8i Max, as it strengthens its challenge to Nvidia in the rapidly growing AI semiconductor market. The 8tx targets secure, confidential computing for governments and regulated industries, while the 8i Max is designed for AI applications requiring longer context windows, including drug discovery, mathematics and software development. Both variants are expected to become available next year. Google is accelerating its chip development cycle, moving from one new AI processor every two years to multiple releases annually. Its TPUs reportedly cost around 30% less than Nvidia GPUs while offering competitive performance and energy efficiency. Major customers include Apple, Meta, Oracle, Anthropic and Jump Trading, while OpenAI is also expected to adopt the technology. $GOOGL

items.title: In June 1929, the public had accepted that the April problems were behind them. Figures like Charles Mitchell, Michael Meehan, Jesse Livermo
items.content_excerpt: In June 1929, the public had accepted that the April problems were behind them. Figures like Charles Mitchell, Michael Meehan, Jesse Livermore and William Durant preached about the strength of their holdings, and the American economy. (think: Sonks only go up) The once skeptical public was now enamored by the excesses of Wall St. Throngs would vacation from across the country to view NYC's financial Mecca. However, the bank owners were pumping the market. They were all completely consumed with keeping the shell game going. A number of inter-bank transactions (many hidden from public view) enabled the institutional banks to prop-up failing regional banks. Eventually this all came to a head because National City's share price couldn't feasibly be pumped above it's imposed acquisition target. The institutions had run out of money, suddenly their cooperation and collusion became transparent. Lesson: Don't trust the salesman, his job is to sell you. $DJT $SPY $DIA $QQQ $VTI
